links.outcome: ChatGPT diagnostic F1 on real clinical reports versus ophthalmologists and interns
links.effect: Best ChatGPT F1 80.05% (English prompt, direct diagnosis), below ophthalmologists (89.35%) but close to interns (82.69%); performance gaps remain
links.quote: ChatGPT using English prompt for direct diagnosis achieved the best performance, with F1-score of 80.05%, which was inferior to ophthalmologists (89.35%) but close to ophthalmologist interns (82.69%).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's diagnostic reasoning and accuracy on Chinese clinical reports across different prompting strategies (language translation vs native Chinese, direct vs explained).

primary.practice: prompt language and explanation framing (prompt engineering)
